record.question: Power to declare dry day/ dry days by the Commissioner is given under_______.
record.explanation: The printed item (PDF page 8, Q49, July 2025 Paper III) asks under which section the Commissioner may declare dry day(s), with options Sections 10 to 13. The dry-day power is recalled as Section 11 of the Mizoram Liquor (Prohibition and Control) Act, 2014, but the section text is not printed in this paper, so this is an unverified recollection and not checked against the Act.
